messages:
olivia_partnerships: Quick proposal — we need a lightweight field triage fallback protocol for marketplace+HW partner launches. Current ad-hoc flow is confusing for partners.
raj_ops: +1. can you sketch the steps? worried about cross-org pings at 02:00.
emma_dev: Proposal: 1) Shared channel naming: #partner-<org>-triage-<env> 2) Default membership: partner liaison, oncall, product SE, eng lead 3) If no response in 10m escalate to dedicated bridge and page SEV lane.
sean_oncall: 10m sounds ok. Suggest also automated notice to partner slack + email. we should avoid broad @here pings.
olivia_partnerships: exact. also add a "fallback bridge" policy: if partner cannot join bridge, we create a joint recording and assign a single Redwood liaison to own the case and bridge notes.
raj_ops: what about SI integrators who want to run their own diagnostic runbooks? we should allow limited read-only perms to logs.
emma_dev: agree. add runbook snippet for limited perms: ```#permissions
- partner_read_logs:true
- partner_start_runbook:false
- escalate_to_oncall:true
```
partner-bot: NOTE: War room template created: /runbooks/partner-field-triage-template. Link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/partner-field-triage
olivia_partnerships: can we add a scheduled dry-run next Wed 09:30 PT? tiny test with CloudVendor and NimbusHW (only 15m).
sean_oncall: I'll take the first rotation. tagging @emma_dev to own the runbook updates.
emma_dev: will update runbook tonight and add checklist: preflight, join instructions, fallback steps, contact matrix.
raj_ops: also propose an automated router: if dedicated bridge fails, route requests to 'redwood-fallback-model' variant and flag partner case for priority processing in the console.
olivia_partnerships: perfect. I'll document and send to partner contacts with steps. tagging legal for any cross-org access consents. :thumbsup:
partner-bot: Reminder scheduled dry-run created for 2765440000 (calendar invite sent).
sean_oncall: thanks — let's keep this short and make sure we don't increase noise. we'll iterate after the dry-run.
